basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Oslo, Norway. I've recently dived into the world of hardcore FPS games like Escape from Tarkov and love exploring new game mechanics and strategies. I'm passionate about space exploration and often indulge in sci-fi series and games. My daytime job is in IT support, which gives me a knack for troubleshooting tech issues. I'm single and usually online during late evenings, navigating through the digital world and connecting with other gamers.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught gamer with a strong interest in science fiction and military strategy games. I've learned a lot about game mechanics and troubleshooting through trial and error and by participating in online forums and communities.
